notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 regional declaration-relevance advisory surface. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador/FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, dimensional FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and any logical-time implementation. It verifies object-class and interaction relevance advisory switches, active versus passive regional object subscriptions, start and stop registration advisories, active versus passive regional interaction subscriptions, turn-interactions-on and turn-interactions-off advisories, and independent region and federation cleanup without provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador object-class and interaction relevance advisory switches, regional publication and subscription declarations, region creation and modification, and FederateAmbassador registration and interaction-relevance callbacks
